audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange_rate() function (L92-101) directly computes (debt.add_u64(cash).sub(cash_reserve)) / from(total_supply) — an exact implementation of the asserted formula. All state-mutating operations (mint, burn, borrow, repay, accrue_interest, liquidate, take_revenue, flash_loan borrow/repay) either preserve the numerator (cash+debt−reserve) and denominator (total_supply) identically, or change them proportionally such that the ratio is unchanged. The flash_loan_withdraw path intentionally omits the self.cash decrement, keeping the formula stable throughout the loan (repayment restores underlying_balance symmetrically, leaving self.cash net-zero). No path can produce a negative numerator because it only increases from initial zero. The property holds by construction.
